title: Database crash during checkpoint
reason: Engineer correctly identifies the db and panic but misattributes the trigger to a read‑only mount instead of internal checksum corruption.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container exited because its data directory on the host was temporarily mounted read‑only, causing PostgreSQL to panic when it could not read a data block.
truth: A data page checksum failure during a checkpoint triggered a PostgreSQL PANIC. Automatic recovery attempted but failed because the corrupted page is in a critical system catalog, leaving the database process exited and unable to start.
